asks.description: Best ask first; ascending price. When available is true, empty means no current liquidity; when it is false, always empty.

available.description: True when the book is current and empty sides mean no liquidity. False while the book is being built or after it was invalidated: its levels are unknown, not empty. Request the snapshot again later.

bids.description: Best bid first; descending price. When available is true, empty means no current liquidity; when it is false, always empty.

bookEpoch.description: Epoch of bookSeq, as a decimal string. Order snapshots by (bookEpoch, bookSeq): a higher epoch is newer whatever its bookSeq, and a new epoch may restart bookSeq. Discard a snapshot whose epoch is older than the newest one seen for the symbol. 0 while available is false.

bookSeq.description: Book sequence of this snapshot within bookEpoch, as a decimal string. Monotonic within one epoch; compare it only with sequences of the same epoch.

depth.description: Depth tier this snapshot was served at: the depth query parameter, or 50 when it was omitted. Set in every response, available or not.

ts.description: Snapshot timestamp as Unix epoch milliseconds; 0 while available is false.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.1: 1 level per side: the best bid and the best ask.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.5000: 5000 levels per side, the deepest snapshot.

ApiKeyIdAuth.description: ID of the API key that signs the request. An API-key request sends it with X-API-TIMESTAMP and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyIdAuth.name: X-API-KEY-ID

ApiKeySignatureAuth.description: Ed25519 signature of the request, made with the API key's private key and encoded as hex or base64. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-TIMESTAMP.
ApiKeySignatureAuth.name: X-API-SIGNATURE

ApiKeyTimestampAuth.description: Time the request was signed, in Unix milliseconds. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyTimestampAuth.name: X-API-TIMESTAMP

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

info.description:
Public trading API for market makers and integrators.
Connect RPC over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with JSON and Protobuf.
info.title: Polyester API

get.description: Retrieve a spot order book depth snapshot for a symbol. Bids are ordered best price first (descending), asks are ordered best price first (ascending), and each level is returned as a [price, quantity] tuple of decimal strings.

parameters.description: Depth tier: price levels per side. Defaults to 50 when omitted; any other value is rejected. To follow the book in real time, subscribe to the order book stream at a streamed tier (1, 20, 50, 200 or 500), then fetch this snapshot at exactly that tier.
parameters.name: depth

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.
